reviewer_role: Independent delegated source and metadata reviewer; not the implementation author
source_check_scope: Independently hashed all 12 frozen source files; examined new analysis, registration and runner modules plus their pure helpers. No model, controller or official engine was imported or invoked.

metadata_source_accounting.kind: Conservative cumulative reviewer charge, rounded upward
metadata_source_accounting.remaining_charge_covers: Final freeze reread, receipt verification and conservative rounding
metadata_source_accounting.includes: Earlier decision and pure helper review, scoped source searches charged at full file lengths, repeated source reads including truncated tool output, full manifest/source identity verification and conservative source-import allowance for one synthetic-only check process

closed_findings.resolution: Each turn stops alignment at its first unequal full input or chosen task; later callback ordinals are never rematched.
A request-effect chain requires an equal-context choice difference on the first-request-difference turn. An earlier or later choice alone leaves the pair unknown.
Effect classification uses only +1, +24 and terminal observed states, clipped and deduplicated; an unsampled transient effect cannot enlarge coverage.
All registered structured input fields and candidate identity/features are required before accepted alignment.
Both observations retain their observation wrapper so both inventory orders are material. Action/request fields and incidental timing do not create a physical difference.
One compressed stream performs hashing and bounded reads; zlib max_length bounds actual decoded output. Missing, duplicate, truncated, hash-mismatched or incomplete raw sets fail closed.
Absent completion events remain unknown. Geometry, adjacent reassignment and move/work request descriptors never count as completion or as support for the duration screen.

runner_checks.memory_enforcement: 0.25-second sampled external monitoring; no claim of OS hard quota; between-sample overshoot remains unknown

budget_interpretation_review.reason: The prospectively stated 16 MiB scope covers registration/analysis verification and independent source/result review. Excluded development browsing and public-content-only privacy checks do not open or replace selected scientific inputs; all work remains inside the original 90-minute wall budget.

remaining_execution_conditions: Create the exact-byte local preregistration commit containing this receipt and all frozen evidence/source.
Run only through the verified single-attempt runner; no selected raw read before its commit verification.
Any input, scalar, budget or source mismatch consumes/closes the attempt without replacement or rerun.
limitations: This is source/metadata pre-review, not proof of the yet-unread raw identities or completed diagnostic results.
The working-set ceiling is sampled, and terminal/first-request reproduction is checked only during the one authorized raw pass.
